title: Register bounds imply the guarded condition
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean symbols, let $\mathrm{mode}$ be a codec mode, let $y$ be a Boolean word, let $B\in\mathbb{N}$, let $l$ be a program label, and let $v$ assign a natural number to each of the 21 registers. If every register value is at most $B$ and the configuration with label $l$, registers $v$, and no pending answer satisfies the codec precondition on $y$, then that configuration satisfies the guard with bound $B$.
